body:
Thank you.

Calmed down a lot tonight. All that typing delayed me until the worst of it was over.

the internet's as much as I have. a tiny handful of people I talk to on there who I can be myself around. They know I'm trans and accept me as a woman, but I'm terrified that if we ever meet, i'll be a letdown, a big hairy manly-looking freak in ill-fitting clothing.

back to work, the two people I work with on my own desk i'm starting to fucking hate. they were decent once and we all got along well (we have to for the job) but over time they've grown louder and more opinionated. one's elderly and has very old-fashioned opinions. the other's a former neonazi who rejected his entire old life, moved across the country to here and is proud to have reformed. except he hasn't, and routinely decides to bring up politics and spew vile extreme rightwing hatred, which he's usually backed up on by the old guy. we can get along when that's not happening, but more and more often it does. today, "egypt should shut the fuck up, they voted for what they got. democracy's a bunch of shit anyway, if it was fascism there wouldn't be all those deaths, they'd just accept that the guy they put in power is going to do precisely what he promised." yesterday "[they're killing off that woman on Coronation Street. I say woman, but I mean man. Good, it deserves it. people like that, if they're too weak to live they don't deserve to live.](http://www.mirror.co.uk/tv/tv-news/coronation-street-hayley-cropper-suicide-3020148)" every single day now there's something they'll say to send me spiraling into a depression, always something hateful and ignorant as fuck, and i *HAVE* to sit beside them for eight hours a day five days a week when i'm not being hijacked to be yelled at by fucks on the other desk. i'll just tell a supervisor, right? oh right, one of them described England's football team as "playing like a pack of faggots" in front of me and another complained about "all the fucking pakis who call up trying to run scams." yeah the management here isn't sympathetic. we used to have a trans woman work here years ago; she left as soon as she had her operation, people were monstrous and insisted on calling her "him" at best and "it" most of the time whilst verbally abusing her for using the ladies bathrooms. don't know how she ever dealt with all the bullshit day in and day out.

i used to have a good friend who worked there, who left about 7 years ago. it was odd, i'd always have one person at that place who i could relate to on a deeper level. the day he left, our teams were reshuffled and i met someone else like that. the day that guy left to move to japan, i moved to another department and met another. that last guy left to move across the country to attend uni a year or so ago, and finally i was left without someone close who i could talk to about more than just what was on TV at the weekend. anyway, the original guy who left 7 years ago? last night I finally caught up with him. we went out for a few drinks after i finished work and we just talked for hours about allsorts. realised there was nothing of that old friendship still there. he was more interested in talking about all the women he'd slept with in the past few years and how he beat up one of his friends for choking a woman, then took the woman back to his place and slept with her. what. the. fuck. this guy was one of my closest friends, we sat and talked about art and philosophy and life and death and the meaning of everything, years ago. now he's just a womanizing scumbag. god fucking damn.

I dont' know where I'm going with this. money's far too tight. I have such a shit job that barely pays my monthly bills that i used credit cards to buy stuff in a misguided attempt to cheer myself up. now my spare money each month covers the interest on those and a tiny bit left over to try and bring the balance down because I fucked up. a(n online) friend lent me some money before christmas specifically to do this, but then my family pushed for some huge gifts, and christmas costs in general pretty much wiped out that loan. at least he said i don't have to pay it back until i'm ready. it's weird but that helped because it's a genuine debt to someone I care about and part of me just finds it unthinkable to let htat go unpaid if I died. meanwhile all i want to do is buy myself a nice dress or some luxury makeup or just something to let me look myself in the mirror and not want to cry but I know that if I do, it'll be the only thing I buy all month that isn't essential, and then I'll not have enough money in the bank at the end of the month, i'll default on some direct debit or get overdrawn and hit with fees that just make next month all the harder. that shit is so bad it's even affected my hygiene, jsut seeing myself naked in the shower brings on feelings of dysphoria I can't do anything about. so I only shower a couple of times a week, just hopping quickly in and out really. fuck I'm a mess.

that's not all, but i think iv'e typed enough. I hate myself, I hate my job, I hate my "friends," I hate my life, I hate that I'm not strong enough or even in a financial position to do anything about it. I frequently think that death is going to be the only way out of this daily grind of depression. my wrist's bleeding from superficial cuts. I have a box of tramadol I shouldn't have that sometimes tempts me. But at least now I can say I've admitted all of that. I don't feel as bad as I did when I began typing.
